ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New work, Enquiry and later stages need Service area and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_work", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Qualified", 2, "Conflict check", 3, "Proposal", 4, "Proposal sent", 5, "Terms agreed", 6, "Engagement letter out", 7, "Closed won", 8, 0) >= 1, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Service_area__c)), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Service area and Next step date before moving to Enquiry.
